result.description: A fictional compact desktop docking hub designed for office hot-desking, featuring dual HDMI outputs, gigabit Ethernet, three USB-A ports, one USB-C data port, and 100W power delivery passthrough. Built for everyday productivity rather than storage or gaming workloads, it emphasizes display expansion and peripheral aggregation in a matte graphite enclosure.
result.title: Nordfall OrbitLink USB-C Docking Hub
